38spc81t7bjwy declare TYPE attrs_cur IS REF CURSOR; m_cur attrs_cur; m_event varchar2(512); m_user varchar2(512); m_owner varchar2(512); m_user1 varchar2(512); m_type varchar2(512); m_name varchar2(5120); end loop; return; end if; if (m_name!='MDSYS' and m_type='USER' and m_event='DROP') then m_stmt:='call sdo_geor_def.doDropUserAndTable()'; execute immediate m_stmt; end if; if (m_owner !='MDSYS' and m_owner!='SYS' and m_type='TABLE' and m_event='DROP') then m_stmt:='call sdo_geor_def.doDropUserAndTable()'; if (m_owner!='MDSYS' and m_owner!='SYS' and m_type='TABLE' and m_event='ALTER') then m_stmt:='call sdo_geor_def.doAlterRenameTable()'; execute immediate m_stmt; end if; if (m_owner!='MDSYS' and m_owner!='SYS' and m_type='TABLE' and m_event='RENAME') then m_stmt:='call sdo_geor_def.doRenameTable()'; EXECUTE IMMEDIATE m_stmt; end if; Exception when others then if(sqlcode= -13391) then m_stmt:=sqlerrm; m_stmt:=substr(m_stmt, 11); m_stmt:='call mderr.raise_md_error(''MD'', ''SDO'', -13391, '''||m_stmt||''')';
